snippet.title: Pompeii: The Legacy - Full Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Full Release – April 9, 2026

Pompeii: The Legacy is a historical city builder where you shape the fate of Pompeii across generations.

Build, govern, and guide your people through prosperity, crisis, and the looming shadow of Vesuvius. Every decision matters, from economy and trade to family legacy and survival.

Starting as a small settlement, you will grow Pompeii into a thriving Roman city, balancing resources, citizen needs, and political choices, while uncovering a story that unfolds over decades.

This is a solo-developed project, built on a custom engine, and shaped by a passion for classic city builders.

Links to purchase the game:
